opening_summary: The focused local snapshot passed 228 tests across 13 files. Production execution passed 2 smoke tests, 19 public GET checks, 3 protected GET checks, 7 anonymous browser observations, 23 authenticated browser observations and 9 additional API checks, with overlapping assertions. The browser and API runs each recorded the payout-availability blocker separately. Of 40 scenario groups, 3 passed, 8 are partial, 15 are blocked and 14 await controlled execution. A separate appendix records 46 local creation boundary tests.
run_context: Production target: https://booking-web-manager.vercel.app. Checks ran on 20 October 2026; individual timestamps are retained in the evidence. The deployed Git revision was not verified. These observations describe the live deployment at execution time, not a guarantee for every scenario.
summary_paragraphs: The public discovery service returned HTTP 200, a valid empty page and Cache-Control: no-store. D05 search-length boundaries passed through HTTP and browser interfaces. D07 malformed-filter inputs passed through HTTP; selected browser time errors were also observed.

Anonymous and signed-in discovery both showed the empty result. Populated filtering, exact-time and pagination fixtures remain unavailable. V07 now passes all six API transport subcases: invalid inputs returned 400, while exact valid enums reached the nonexistent-session 404 response. No saved visibility change is claimed.

Neoh Session QA was created and signed in. Creation API returned 409 PAYOUT_ACCOUNT_NOT_READY, and the hosted API returned 200 with zero sessions. Payout-account GET returned 503 PAYOUTS_UNAVAILABLE. Wallet balances were zero and top-up UI said coming soon, preventing owned-session and funded-participant fixtures.
